superseded_record_text.notes: Room-temperature (23+/-3 degC) magnetite BM3. V0 and its propagated error come from the paper's a0=8.394(3) A sample, not the independent structural lattice in this file. K0'=4+/-0.4 was assumed, and the authors formed the +/-10 GPa K0 uncertainty by adding fit, NaCl pressure-scale, and assumed-K0' contributions; it is not a covariance-derived one-sigma error. The low-pressure spinel reflections persist to 32 GPa, but a high-pressure phase begins to coexist above about 25 GPa.
